subject.title: Feishu card action: pass through form_value, input_value and other fields

question: What agent-visible payload contract should Feishu card actions expose for `form_value`, `input_value`, `option`, `options`, and `name`?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the exact JSON-vs-command-text shape becomes channel behavior that must preserve existing simple button command handling.

options.title: Structured passthrough
options.body: Refresh the linked PR around a structured JSON payload for non-button fields while keeping simple button commands unchanged.

options.title: Command-text append
options.body: Append fields to existing command text only if maintainers accept quoting and value-serialization rules for downstream parsers.

options.title: Limit initial scope
options.body: Ship only `form_value` first and leave selectors, input values, and names to a follow-up contract decision.

recommendation.title: Structured passthrough
recommendation.body: Refresh the linked PR around a structured JSON payload for non-button fields while keeping simple button commands unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the declared Feishu plugin contact and best available owner for the channel payload contract.
